The '''Giant's Spear Mesa''' was a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. It housed a secret facility that housed and constructed the [[The Ark]] during the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] takeover of the planet.
